Add B1-B6_WinRate_vs_Avg and vs_Max (relative player skill diff for all lanes)

Add B1-B6_Tilt_vs_Avg (per-lane tilt relative to race mean)
Add WeatherID label encoding (sunny/cloudy/rain weather condition)
Add B1-B6_Combined_Rank (ExTime_Rank x WinRate_Rank product, motor+skill strength)
Add B1-B6_ExTime_NormPos (ExTime_vs_Min normalized by field spread, 0=fastest 1=slowest)
Add ExTime_Std (race-level ExTime standard deviation, motor competitiveness spread)
Add B1-B6_MotorWinRate_Rank (within-race rank of historical motor win rate, 1=best)
Add B1-B6_ExTimeGap_x_MWR (ExTime_vs_Min * MotorWinRate, race-day motor speed * historical win rate)
Add B1-B6_Course_2in_Rank (within-race rank of course-specific 2nd place rate)
Add B1-B6_Course_Win_Rank (within-race rank of course-specific 1st place rate)
Add B1-B6_RankScore_Rank (within-race rank of official class A1/A2/B1/B2, 1=highest class)
Add B1-B6_Course_3in_Rank (within-race rank of course-specific 3rd place rate)
Add B1-B6_ExTime_x_C2in_Rank (ExTime_Rank * Course_2in_Rank compound, motor speed x 2nd-place stability)
Add B1-B6_Course_2in_vs_Avg (2nd-place rate vs race mean, continuous relative advantage)
Add B1-B6_ExTimeGap_x_Wave (ExTime_vs_Min * Wave, motor gap amplified by rough water)
Add B1-B6_WinRate_x_C2in (WinRate * Course_2in, player skill x course stability compound)
Add B1-B6_Course_Total3 (Course_Win + Course_2in + Course_3in sum, total course consistency)
Add Avg_Course_2in and Course_2in_Spread (race-level 2nd-place rate mean and spread)
Add B1-B6_Course_3in_Only (Course_3in - Course_2in, pure 3rd-place tendency excluding 2nd or 1st)
Add B1-B6_MotorWinRate_vs_Avg (motor win rate minus race mean, continuous relative motor strength)
Add B1-B6_Win_to_2in_Ratio (Course_Win / Course_2in, win vs place tendency for each boat)
Add B1-B6_RankScore_vs_Avg (each boat rank score minus race mean, continuous class relative advantage)
Add B1-B6_WinRate_vs_Min (player win rate minus race min win rate, absolute advantage over weakest)
Add B1-B6_Tilt_Rank (within-race rank of tilt adjustment, 1=most aggressive propeller setting)
Add ExTime_Top2_Gap (2nd fastest minus fastest ExTime, measures motor leader dominance in race)
Add B1-B6_Motor2inRate_Rank (within-race rank of motor 2nd-place historical rate, 1=best motor for 2nd place)
Add B1-B6_CourseFit (Course_Win - WinRate, how well player fits their current lane vs overall skill)
Add B1-B6_Motor2inRate_vs_Avg (motor 2nd-place rate minus race mean, continuous motor 2nd-place advantage)
Add B1-B6_ExTime_x_WRRank (ExTime_vs_Min * WinRate_Rank, combined motor-gap and player-skill weakness indicator)
Add B1-B6_2nd_Score (ExTime_Rank + Course_2in_Rank sum, lower=stronger 2nd-place candidate)
Add B1-B6_ExTime_x_C2inRank (ExTime_vs_Min * Course_2in_Rank, motor gap amplified by 2nd-place course rank)
Add B1-B6_CourseFitRatio (Course_Win / MaxCourseWin across all lanes, how well player fits current lane vs their best lane)
Add B1-B6_Tilt_x_ExTime (Tilt * ExTime_vs_Min, motor compensating strategy via propeller adjustment)
Add B1-B6_Weight_Rank (within-race rank of rider weight, 1=lightest, lighter may be faster)
Add B1-B6_Has_Fastest (binary flag: 1 if this boat has the fastest ExTime in race, identifies motor leader)
Add B1-B6_BestCourseWin_Rank (rank of player's best course win rate across all 6 lanes, true skill ceiling)
Add B1-B6_Count_Rank (within-race rank of career race count, 1=most experienced, reliability of historical stats)
Add B1-B6_C2in_x_ETStrength (Course_2in * (7 - ExTime_Rank), 2nd-place course rate weighted by motor strength)
Add B1B2_ExTime_Gap (B2_ExTime_vs_Min - B1_ExTime_vs_Min, direct head-to-head motor gap between lane 1 and 2)
Add B1-B6_WR_x_CWin (WinRate * Course_Win, player overall win rate x course-specific 1st place rate compound)
Add B1-B6_WR_x_ETStrength (WinRate * (7 - ExTime_Rank), player skill weighted by motor speed strength)
Add B1-B6_Course_3in_vs_Avg (course-specific 3rd place rate minus race mean, continuous relative 3rd-place advantage)
Add B1-B6_ET_C2in_Product (ExTime_Rank * Course_2in_Rank product, lower=stronger 2nd-place motor+course candidate)
Add B1-B6_Course_2in_vs_Min (course 2nd-place rate minus race minimum, advantage over weakest 2nd-place boat)
Add B1-B6_BestCWin (player's best win rate across all 6 lane positions, true skill ceiling as raw value)
Add B1-B6_VenueWinRate (player venue-specific win rate from race history, captures venue familiarity beyond overall WinRate)
Add B1-B6_VenueAdapt (VenueWinRate - WinRate, venue-specific advantage over career average)
Add B1-B6_Venue2inRate (player venue-specific 2nd place rate, venue familiarity for 2nd place)
Add B1-B6_VenueWinRate_Rank (within-race rank of venue-specific win rate, 1=best venue fit)
Add B1-B6_VenueLaneWR (venue x lane historical win rate, captures venue-specific lane advantage bias)
Add B1-B6_Career2inRate and Career3inRate (overall career 2nd/3rd place rates, not lane-specific)
Add B1-B6_Career2in_Rank (within-race rank of career overall 2nd place rate, 1=strongest 2nd-place tendency)
Add ExTimeMin_vs_VenueAvg (race ExTime_Min relative to venue historical average, captures unusually fast/slow motor conditions)
Add AvgWR_vs_VenueAvg (race average WinRate relative to venue historical average, field strength relative to venue norm)
Add B1-B6_VenueWR_vs_Avg (VenueWinRate minus race mean VenueWinRate, relative venue advantage among field)
Add B1-B6_CareerTop3Rate (sum of WinRate + Career2inRate + Career3inRate, measures overall top-3 consistency)
Add B1-B6_VenueWR_x_ExTimeAdv (VenueWinRate times negative ExTime_vs_Min, captures venue-strong player with fast motor)
Add B1-B6_VenueLaneWinRate (historical win rate of lane X at venue Y, captures venue course structure bias independent of player)
Add B1-B6_VenueRaceCount (player's total race count at each venue, captures course familiarity)
Add B1-B6_VenueLanePWinRate (player win rate at specific venue AND lane combo, min 3 races, fallback to VenueWinRate)
Add B1-B6_VenueLanePWR_Rank (within-race rank of VenueLanePWinRate, 1=strongest venue-lane adapted player in race)
Add B1-B6_VenueLane_vs_VenueWR (VenueLanePWinRate minus VenueWinRate, lane-specific edge over player venue average)
Add B1-B6_VenueLanePWR_x_C2in (VenueLanePWinRate * Career2inRate, venue-lane mastery times career 2nd place consistency)
Add B1-B6_VenueLanePWR_x_ExAdv (VenueLanePWinRate * negative ExTime_vs_Min, venue-lane expert with fast motor today)
